title: Boolean studio
description: A lacquer-red solid is joined, cut or intersected by a movable sphere.
useCase: Explore constructive geometry through three explicit operations and direct cutter positioning.
interaction: Choose Join, Cut or Intersect; drag the cutter or adjust its position.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Analytic box/sphere CSG with local shading, no mesh export or CAD topology.
look: Glossy lacquer-red rounded box with a spherical cavity and bright specular highlight on a flat pale grey-blue field; three square-cornered mode buttons top left.
motion: The raymarched box slowly sways while a sphere joins, cuts or intersects it per the chosen mode; dragging the canvas or slider moves the sphere sideways, reshaping the solid instantly.
adapt: Geometry is the SDF in `FRAGMENT`: `box` and the sphere inside `model` combine with `min` or `max` according to `u_mode`, and `u_control` sets the sphere's x. Tune the red `vec3(.7,.065,.037)` and the sway in `local`; keep the context-loss fallback.
